goals.title: Ship production-quality Rust systems
goals.observable: Release PULSE with reproducible correctness, recovery, security, and operational evidence.

goals.title: Build reliable data infrastructure in Rust
goals.observable: Release QUAY only after PULSE and prove bounded Arrow/Parquet/query/streaming behavior.

goals.title: Reason explicitly about distributed failure
goals.observable: Pass fresh design and failure-mode assessments with invariants, SLOs, recovery boundaries, and residual risks.

goals.title: Select and prove algorithm patterns independently
goals.observable: Solve delayed mixed items and transfer the selected invariants into PULSE, QUAY, and TESSERA stages without solution support.

goals.title: Produce inspectable public engineering proof
goals.observable: Publish versioned design, test, benchmark, security, and operations artifacts for each released flagship without exposing private source material.
